title: keteleeria davidiana subsp. pubescens
intro: Keteleeria davidiana subsp. pubescens, commonly known as Korean fir, is a plant species in the family Pinaceae. It is a coniferous evergreen tree native to the Korean Peninsula. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate conditions such as arthritis and wound infections. The bioactive constituents of Korean fir include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
